77978.desc: A Love Letter to the Land. Mist settles silently into the valleys below while the escarpment rises above it, creating the illusion of distant snow-covered hills. As the sun climbs, the fog slowly lifts and another day on the mountain begins. Mountain living is something special. It isn't for everyone. But those who embrace it rarely want to leave. There is a peace here that is difficult to articulate until you experience it for yourself. The air feels different. The seasons are more pronounced. The silence is punctuated by the extraordinary calls of resident lyrebirds - ancient, almost prehistoric sounds echoing through the surrounding forest. Whether your vision is to run cattle, breed horses, create an equestrian retreat, or simply enjoy a peaceful rural lifestyle, Glendale Homestead offers an unrivalled foundation. Set right in the centre of Witta and only minutes from the Maleny township, Glendale Homestead offers the rare combination of complete privacy with convenience. The cafés, schools, and community spirit that define this region are all within easy reach, yet from the moment you enter, the rest of the world feels far away. Properties of this scale, quality, and location are almost never offered to market. Glendale Homestead is one of those rare places that will speak to those who value land with history, soul, and limitless potential, a true legacy property ready for its next chapter.
